rules.source: pin exact immutable source HEAD and TREE; verify complete package digest before execution
rules.reproducibility: deploy/recover from the instance's packaged code and declared configuration; no implicit online mutable dependencies
rules.portable: provider-specific adapters may resolve externally, must be versioned and disclosed
rules.secrets: never embed secret values, credentials, signing keys, protected host identity or private certs in the instance package
rules.admission: configuration and tests cannot set EFFECT_ACK_DONE; require separately authorized host, native effect and independent original readback
rules.recovery: no replay of ambiguous irreversible effect; inspect original ledger and fence writers first
rules.governance: respect applicable owner license, code owner review, integrity trio and runtime admission
